violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Can opener base/stand
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sugar, salt, flour, etc. Sauces in unmarked squeeze bottles also breed to b e labeled, to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.After each use, soap wet wiping towels in sanitizing solution. Frequently check the sanitizer in the solution in solution for proper concentration.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Sauces in unmarked squeeze bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Unmarked squeezed bottles were labeled during the inspection, to identify sauces.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Food employees observed wearing jewelry (Watch and Bracelet) on their arms and hands.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse container outside the facility. The area within the dumpster fence ed area is in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. Sweep inside the fenced area of the dumpster to remove refuse on the ground.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the oped wire shelving in the walk-in refrigerator are rusty and need to be resurfaced or be replaced if they are no longer repairable.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Santini's - Oakton (Inspection Date: 05/06/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the shelving inside Refrigerator are dusty and in of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
